## Releasing it as CC0?

<!-- Only if you set `license: "CC0"` on your entry. Leave this section alone otherwise:
     keeping all rights to your piece is completely fine. -->

**What this means:** CC0 puts your piece in the public domain, like Mal. Anyone can use it, change it, sell it, or train on it, without asking you or crediting you. **This can't be undone:** once it's out there, it stays free, even if you change your mind later.

If your piece is based on someone else's fan art that isn't CC0, your CC0 only covers what you added.

- [ ] **This is my own work**, and I have the right to give it away. It doesn't include anyone else's art, characters or photos that aren't free to use.
- [ ] **I understand CC0 is permanent** and I'm waiving my copyright in this piece, as described in the [CC0 1.0 Universal deed](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/).
